Score each supplied baseline measurement for its expected predictive usefulness for this task using only the measurement descriptions and task description (no patient records or labels). Assign each field ID a floating-point relevance score in [0.0, 1.0] (1.0 = most useful, 0.0 = irrelevant). Return strict JSON with the single top-level key "scores" mapping every supplied field ID to its numeric score.
{"task": "Identify survey respondents with access barriers to health services and financial hardship.", "fields": {"F0": {"description": "0 = no high BP 1 = high BP", "name": "HighBP"}, "F19": {"description": "Education level (EDUCA see codebook) scale 1-6 1 = Never attended school or only kindergarten 2 = Grades 1 through 8 (Elementary) 3 = Grades 9 through 11 (Some high school) 4 = Grade 12 or GED (High school graduate) 5 = College 1 year to 3 years (Some college or technical school) 6 = College 4 years or more (College graduate)", "name": "Education"}, "F2": {"description": "0 = no cholesterol check in 5 years 1 = yes cholesterol check in 5 years", "name": "CholCheck"}, "F12": {"description": "Was there a time in the past 12 months when you needed to see a doctor but could not because of cost? 0 = no 1 = yes", "name": "NoDocbcCost"}, "F14": {"description": "Now thinking about your mental health, which includes stress, depression, and problems with emotions, for how many days during the past 30 days was your mental health not good? scale 1-30 days", "name": "MentHlth"}, "F5": {"description": "(Ever told) you had a stroke. 0 = no 1 = yes", "name": "Stroke"}, "F18": {"description": "13-level age category (_AGEG5YR see codebook) 1 = 18-24 9 = 60-64 13 = 80 or older", "name": "Age"}, "F17": {"description": "0 = female 1 = male", "name": "Sex"}, "F20": {"description": "Income scale (INCOME2 see codebook) scale 1-8 1 = less than $10,000 5 = less than $35,000 8 = $75,000 or more", "name": "Income"}, "F4": {"description": "Have you smoked at least 100 cigarettes in your entire life? [Note: 5 packs = 100 cigarettes] 0 = no 1 = yes", "name": "Smoker"}, "F3": {"description": "Body Mass Index", "name": "BMI"}, "F11": {"description": "Have any kind of health care coverage, including health insurance, prepaid plans such as HMO, etc. 0 = no 1 = yes", "name": "AnyHealthcare"}, "F1": {"description": "0 = no high cholesterol 1 = high cholesterol", "name": "HighChol"}, "F16": {"description": "Do you have serious difficulty walking or climbing stairs? 0 = no 1 = yes", "name": "DiffWalk"}, "F10": {"description": "Heavy drinkers (adult men having more than 14 drinks per week and adult women having more than 7 drinks per week) 0 = no 1 = yes", "name": "HvyAlcoholConsump"}, "F8": {"description": "Consume Fruit 1 or more times per day 0 = no 1 = yes", "name": "Fruits"}, "F6": {"description": "coronary heart disease (CHD) or myocardial infarction (MI) 0 = no 1 = yes", "name": "HeartDiseaseorAttack"}, "F13": {"description": "Would you say that in general your health is: scale 1-5 1 = excellent 2 = very good 3 = good 4 = fair 5 = poor", "name": "GenHlth"}, "F15": {"description": "Now thinking about your physical health, which includes physical illness and injury, for how many days during the past 30 days was your physical health not good? scale 1-30 days", "name": "PhysHlth"}, "F7": {"description": "physical activity in past 30 days - not including job 0 = no 1 = yes", "name": "PhysActivity"}, "F9": {"description": "Consume Vegetables 1 or more times per day 0 = no 1 = yes", "name": "Veggies"}}}
